scope: New digital tasks can persist worker-reported plans in the existing timeline; explicit resume retains execution identity and notes. Old action receipts do not consume the new-attempt action budget. Saved plans do not prove completed external work.
limits: No automatic multi-day scheduler or broader autonomy completion claim.
Previous release profiles are not silently migrated.
Step completion is worker-reported, not independently verified.
rollback: baseline.compose.private.json in installation stage; original core and worker images retained
